Lessons.Title: Stories with Fractions
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will use understanding of equivalence to solve addition and subtraction problems with decimal fractions.
In a previous lesson, you solved word problems that involved adding and subtracting fractions and using equivalent fractions. Here, you continue to apply your understanding of fractions to solve problems that require adding or subtracting decimal fractions. You also show your understanding of the structure of fractions and word problems to create your own situations given a value or equation and some constraints.

2021 source activity sequence: Warm-up: Number Talk: One Whole, Many Names (10 minutes); Activity 1: Relay Race at Recess (20 minutes); Activity 2: You Be the Author (15 minutes); Cool-down: Mai’s Milky Cereal (5 minutes)
Math focus: Use equivalence between tenths and hundredths to add or subtract decimal fractions, and author a story whose quantities match its operations.
Worked Edulytics example: Align hundredth place values: 0.65 = 65/100 and 0.27 = 27/100. Add 65/100 + 27/100 = 92/100. Write the result as 0.92 and explain the corresponding context.
First-party Edulytics Cool-down (publisher's original not inspected): A relay runner took 1.30 minutes; a second runner took 0.47 minutes less. How long did the second runner take?
Original models, source figures, student-authored problems and teacher-scored explanations require separate academic review.
